title: Edit-time standards load as native path-scoped rules, the hook serves only Bash
body:
Evidence: operator note 2026-11-18; docs https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md: a .claude/rules/*.md file with paths: frontmatter loads when Claude uses Read, Write or Edit on a matching file (Bash only for single-file reads like cat/head); reloads on demand after /compact. KRN's PreToolUse hook injects 'Standards for editing X' on every call (ADR 0022 wants fewer hook processes, lower p50).
Outcome: krn generates .claude/rules/ files from .agents/records.json path keys; the PreToolUse standards injection runs only for Bash commands naming files; tests/retrieval eval show edit recall unchanged (>= 0.76 of all labels) and hook process count per Edit drops to zero for standards.
Proof: node evals/retrieval/run.ts: edit recall >= 0.76 of all labels
Files: src/hook/edit-standards.ts, .claude/rules/
